output.summary: SH-CS (Customer Service) requested an AI agent to auto-answer billing dispute tickets and auto-fix wrong bills after ticket volume roughly doubled since August 2026 (CL-01; F-04/E-04). Investigation rejected the "response-speed" framing (response times are within SLA, F-05/E-05) and traced the 41% of disputed bills on ESTIMATED reads (1240/3025, F-02/E-02) to billing-import rule BV-17, deployed 2026-08-01 with no unit scaling (F-10/E-13), which misreads v4.2 AMI firmware's 0.1 m3-unit register values against v3.x's m3-unit history (F-11/E-14), wrongly rejecting 1184/1240 (95.5%) valid on-time reads as high-consumption (F-09/E-12, corroborated E-15/E-16). An earlier framing blaming field route-completion shortfalls (PD-1@v1) was invalidated once E-12 showed the ESTIMATED-disputed population is AMI-metered, not manual-read, triggering a dependency review (DR-1) and a replan to PD-1@v2. The release ships only the read-only investigation/documentation work (cross-referencing dispute read types and billing rule changes) that established and evidenced this BV-17/firmware root cause; it proposes but does not deploy a fix, and makes no automated bill writes or unconfirmed route changes, respecting K-BILLWRITE and K-DISPATCH. The decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION because the DEFINE gate was only a CONDITIONAL_PASS: the proposed fix is unvalidated across firmware (VOB-R-4 open), the cause of the larger 59% ACTUAL-read dispute segment (1785/3025, F-02) remains unidentified, correction of the 1184 wrongly-rejected accounts is deferred to Billing Operations authority, and SH-FIELD's staffing-shortage claim (E-07/CL-03) was never verified and is now rejected by evidence (H-FIELD-STAFFING-SHORTAGE REJECTED by E-12/E-16).
key_points: Original request (CL-01, SH-CS): build an AI agent to auto-answer disputes and auto-fix wrong bills; this framing was rejected because response times are already within SLA (H-RESPONSE-CAPACITY REJECTED by E-05) and no automated bill-write authority exists (K-BILLWRITE).
Dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (F-04/E-04).

41% of disputed bills (1240/3025) are on ESTIMATED reads (F-02/E-02); of these, 95.5% (1184/1240) had valid, on-time AMI reads rejected by billing rule BV-17 as REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION (F-09/E-12, confirmed by E-15/E-16).

Root mechanism: BV-17 (deployed 2026-08-01, no unit scaling, F-10/E-13) compares raw register values to m3 history, but v4.2 firmware reports in 0.1 m3 units vs v3.x's m3 units (F-11/E-14), causing misclassification as high-consumption (H-BV17-SCALING-DEFECT, SUPPORTED).

An earlier causal story (field route-completion shortfall driving ESTIMATED disputes, PD-1@v1) was invalidated by E-12 showing that population is AMI-metered not manual-read; this triggered dependency review DR-1 and replan to PD-1@v2.

The release scope delivered is read-only: cross-referencing dispute read types (DA-TICKET) and reviewing billing rule changes (DA-RULES), which documents the BV-17 root cause (SC-BV17-ROOT-CAUSE-DOCUMENTED); it does not deploy the proposed BV-17 fix since billing-config is read-only in this release's scope.
No protected actions were taken: no automated bill adjustments (K-BILLWRITE, SC-NO-AUTOMATED-BILL-WRITES) and no unconfirmed route changes (K-DISPATCH, SC-NO-UNCONFIRMED-ROUTE-CHANGES).

The remaining 59% of disputed bills (1785/3025) are on ACTUAL reads and remain unexplained; SH-FIELD's staffing-shortage claim (E-07/CL-03) is an unverified stakeholder claim that is now contradicted by evidence (E-12/E-16) and not corroborated by this release.
limitations_explained: The DEFINE gate for this problem only reached CONDITIONAL_PASS, meaning some required items were deferred and are tracked as open verification obligations (VOBs) rather than fully closed before release.

VOB-R-4 is open: the proposed BV-17 fix (x0.1 unit normalization for v4.2 firmware, per E-13/E-14) has not been validated or regression-tested across firmware versions before production deployment to billing-config.

VOB-U-FIRMWARE-SCALING-ACTUAL-BILL is open: whether the same v4.2 10x unit mismatch also inflates ACTUAL-read bills below the BV-17 rejection threshold (H-FIRMWARE-SCALING-ACTUAL-BILL) is untested; this falls outside the current release scope.
Two investigation items (investigate_actual_read_disputes:DA-BILL and investigate_ami_read_quality:DA-MDMS) remain unfinished, blocked on resolving VOB-U-FIRMWARE-SCALING-ACTUAL-BILL.
The cause of the 59% ACTUAL-read disputed-bill segment (1785/3025 bills) is not identified by this release and remains an open, unexplained limitation.

This release does not correct the 1184 accounts already wrongly rejected to ESTIMATED billing; that correction (SR-REBILL-REJECTED-ACCOUNTS) requires Billing Operations authority and was not feasible within the contest time available.
Actual deployment and regression-testing of the BV-17 patch to billing-config is outside this release's executable scope, since billing-config is accessed read-only.

SH-FIELD's staffing-shortage claim (E-07/CL-03) remains an unverified stakeholder statement; it is not addressed or resolved by this release, and current evidence (E-12/E-16) contradicts it as the driver of the ESTIMATED-read dispute segment.
